title: Stone pelting, tear gas and clashes with police: Why Ujjain is on the boil
content: Police used tear gas shells to control a crowd in the city as stone pelting occurred when a large group of people clashed with them at the spot where a portion of Shahi Masjid was planned to be demolished. Rapid Action Force (RAF) personnel has been deployed at the spot.

title: No irrigation, farmers put up Maharashtra village ‘for sale’
content: Residents of Tulshi village in Maharashtra express their frustration over the lack of irrigation water for decades. Despite being close to a major irrigation project, the village has yet to benefit from it. The ongoing water crisis has intensified with no rainfall recorded in the last 45 days. Villagers have resorted to protests, including an indefinite fast, to demand government action.

title: Nidhi Tiwari, influencer with 16 lakh followers, dies by suicide; final words stun fans
content: Nidhi Tiwari, a 30-year-old social media influencer, was found hanging at her residence in Singrauli. Her family reported that she had recently spoken to a youth from another state before her death. The local police are investigating the circumstances surrounding her death and have taken her body into custody. Tiwari had a significant following on social media, indicating her influence in the community.

title: Bill Gates Foundation to shut down in 2045: Why some Americans reject its $400m ‘gift’
content: The Bill Gates Foundation is making a bold move by committing $1 billion to ensure equitable AI development for education and healthcare. Of this, $400 million is dedicated to creating AI-driven tutoring systems that tailor learning experiences. This investment arrives amidst rising discussions about digital tools' effectiveness and privacy issues, with New York City already enacting a one-year pause on generative AI in schools.

title: 14-year-old Georgia student scores perfect 1600 on SAT
content: At just 14 years old, Ashrit Talluri from Georgia has achieved remarkable success, scoring a flawless 1600 on the SAT exam. Having earned 14½ high school credits in middle school, he is now taking college-level courses as a ninth grader at Innovation Academy. With five months of meticulous preparation behind him, Ashrit dreams of becoming a neurosurgeon, eager to delve into projects that combine cutting-edge technology with healthcare.

title: MHA scraps 34 CISF posts after withdrawal from Patanjali food and herbal park
content: The home ministry has issued orders for the abolition of 34 sanctioned posts of the CISF at Patanjali Food and Herbal Park. This decision follows the withdrawal of CISF security services, which took place on May 4, 2026. The CISF had been providing security at the site since June 2015, after a violent incident. The ministry also instructed the CISF to ensure all outstanding dues are settled with the management.

title: 'Leave us alone': 3 students say LPU posted rape 'truth' video without consent
content: Three female students from Lovely Professional University stated that a video of them was released without their consent. This video allegedly dismissed claims of a rape incident on campus involving a plumber. Following the allegations, students protested and vandalized property and blocked a highway for over 15 hours.

title: Why 6 minutes can feel like forever at ITO
content: At the ITO intersection in Delhi, daily commuters face overwhelming delays caused by heavy traffic during rush hours. This crucial junction connects key areas, intensifying congestion. Despite attempts from traffic police to manually control signals, their efforts have proven inadequate against the sheer volume of vehicles. Breakdowns and emergencies further disrupt the flow, leaving commuters to grapple with prolonged wait times as much-needed infrastructure changes remain pending.

title: Pakistan's rooftop solar boom saves $12B in fuel imports
content: Pakistan's transition to solar power has enabled millions of households to rely on renewable energy. The country began this shift during the Ukraine War due to soaring electricity prices and fuel import challenges. Grassroots movements contributed to the rapid installation of solar panels across urban and rural areas. This increased capacity has saved Pakistan over $12 billion in fossil fuel expenses since the transition.

title: US labor dept hints at 'total shutdown' of H-1B visa program
content: Anthony D'Esposito, Inspector General at the Department of Labor, announced an investigation into the H-1B visa program. Investigators are focusing on fraud related to foreign labor, which may lead to significant reforms. D'Esposito indicated that the program could look very different in one year. The administration is also examining colleges allegedly exploiting J-1 visas, as part of a wider crackdown.

title: Bihar boy missing since 2005 train ride found after 21 years via Facebook video
content: At just 15 years old, Ram Shanker Kushwaha vanished while pursuing his wanderlust on a train. For years, his family faced an agonizing wait until Gwalior DSP Santosh Patel shared a video of Ram on Facebook. This led Ram's brother to connect with authorities, and after procedural formalities, Ram triumphantly returned to a heartwarming homecoming embraced by family and community, marking a profound reunion that had been desperately anticipated.

title: David Robinson’s $9M school gives underserved children access to education
content: David Robinson embarked on his journey of educational philanthropy while still in the NBA, beginning with a commitment to fund scholarships for fifth-graders. His vision led to the establishment of Carver Academy, supported by $9 million aimed at enriching the lives of children in San Antonio. Over time, the initiative grew, increasing scholarship amounts and forming partnerships to broaden educational access.

title: Derek Jeter’s rookie-year promise has grown into a 30-year legacy
content: Derek Jeter and his father, Dr. Charles Jeter, launched the Turn 2 Foundation in 1996 during Jeter’s rookie MLB season to encourage young people to avoid drugs and alcohol and pursue healthier lifestyles. Thirty years later, Turn 2 has given back more than $48 million. Its Turn 2 Us programme has also reached more than 30,000 students, families and school staff through community and school-based initiatives.

title: Rakul Preet, Panorama Studios on I-T radar; 12 Mumbai sites searched
content: The Income Tax Department is currently conducting searches at multiple locations linked to actor Rakul Preet Singh and producer Vashu Bhagnani. Officials are investigating suspected financial irregularities connected to film-related transactions and overseas fund movements. Teams are examining documents and transaction records aiming to uncover details about the financial activities under scrutiny. This action follows a separate investigation involving Rakul's brother Aman Preet Singh linked to drug allegations.

title: Paid for AC bus, got non-AC ride and was dropped 10 km early; commission orders Rs 31,500
content: A passenger booked an AC bus ticket from Hyderabad to Rajahmundry but was placed in a non-AC bus. After being dropped off 9-10 km from his destination, he faced significant inconvenience at midnight. The consumer commission found the bus operator liable for deficiency of service due to the circumstances experienced by the passenger. It awarded the passenger Rs 31,500 in total for mental harassment and litigation costs.

title: After hydrogen, India gets its first LNG train; check details
content: The dual-fuel arrangement allows LNG to substitute for around 40 per cent of diesel consumption. The move is part of the national transporter’s broader push to reduce carbon emissions and move towards more sustainable modes of transport. A full tank of LNG is expected to support around 1,600 km of operations, thereby reducing the frequency with which the train needs to refuel.

title: Students, faculty of Kolkata's Ray Institute hurt in clashes with RSS-linked outfit
content: Around thirty students and two faculty members from Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute were injured during a clash. This incident occurred when members of ABGP confronted students protesting an event at their auditorium. Injured students were treated at local hospitals, with some suffering serious injuries from the confrontation. Both sides accused the police of inaction, leading to multiple FIRs being lodged.

title: Entitlement, deviant thinking or poor impulse control? Why men commit sexual crimes
content: Psychiatrists explain that many factors contribute to the occurrence of sexual assault, including personality deviations and societal influences. Various motivations may drive assaulters, such as narcissistic entitlement and impulsive behavior. Urbanization and the impact of social media can exacerbate these issues and diminish fear of legal consequences. Education about mental health, gender equality, and respect for women is crucial in prevention.

title: Houston's Greenspoint Mall to be razed for $150M 80-acre industrial park
content: Greenspoint Mall, a once-popular shopping destination, is set to be demolished for redevelopment. CityNorth Industrial Park will cover approximately 80 acres with an investment of $150 million. This new project will provide logistics and industrial space while supporting approximately 1,200 full-time jobs upon completion. Demolition is scheduled to begin in October 2026, with construction continuing into 2028.

title: Glen Mills grad turned home cooking into digital career with 8M+ followers
content: Shereen Pavlides, a 1990 Garnet Valley High School graduate and former Glen Mills resident, has built a social media career around home cooking. Known as Cooking With Shereen, she now has about 5 million TikTok followers, more than 2 million on Facebook, over 1 million on Instagram and around 1.45 million YouTube subscribers.

title: Why choosing pets over kids may reveal your core values: Psychology
content: Decisions regarding parenthood and pet ownership stem from individual experiences and preferences. Financial considerations play a significant role in deciding between children and pets. Psychologically, bonds with animals are valuable but differ from parent-child relationships. Pets can offer companionship and emotional support without replacing the unique aspects of child-rearing. Ultimately, personal values shape these important life choices for individuals.

title: White House posts third taxpayer-paid ad campaign boosting Trump
content: Trump's latest taxpayer-funded promotions, which prominently display his rhetoric, have ignited debate around the appropriate use of government resources. Detractors from various political factions are voicing concerns over the legality of blending political messaging with public funds. The White House defends these promotions as necessary public service announcements, contrasting with the emerging calls for greater ethical scrutiny during this election cycle.

title: 'No basic public safety': SC pulls up system amid rising rape cases in Delhi
content: The Supreme Court has proactively recognized the alarming surge in rape incidents within Delhi-NCR, accusing law enforcement and public administration of systemic failures in ensuring safety. Drawing comparisons to the infamous 2012 Nirbhaya case, the court expressed dissatisfaction with the advancements in law enforcement. In light of a recent gang-rape, it demanded greater accountability and tangible actions from authorities to enhance public safety and restore faith in institutional responses.

title: OpenAI and Anthropic chased Human Intelligence; how they may be 'fearing' it now
content: OpenAI and Anthropic are adjusting their approach as AI systems become more independent and capable. Both companies emphasize the need for safety measures alongside continued development of advanced AI. Anthropic's CEO, Dario Amodei, recently called for a slower pace of AI development to mitigate risks. OpenAI's CEO, Sam Altman, agreed and highlighted potential dangers from losing control of powerful AI.

title: Netanyahu, holding ICC arrest warrant, wants to build case against Turkey's Erdogan
content: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has instructed a team to prepare a case against Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. This potential legal action will focus on Erdogan's treatment of Kurds and alleged support for Hamas. Human rights organizations have criticized Turkey for its treatment of Kurdish minorities over several decades. Relations between Israel and Turkey have sharply deteriorated, prompting both nations to pursue legal actions against each other.

title: Last-minute dash, chaos, weight cut attempt: How Varun Sanyal's nightmare unfolded
content: Varun Sanyal’s Asian Games journey was marked by travel chaos, logistical hurdles, and an extreme weight cut that ended his campaign before it began. Despite the setback, he played a key support role as teammate Suchika Tariyal won India’s first MMA medal at the Games.

title: Rape 'rumours', a suicide and loot: What happened at LPU - explained in 10 pts
content: Violent protests erupted at Lovely Professional University after claims of a female student's alleged rape on campus. The unrest was compounded by the suicide of another student, prompting students to voice safety concerns. Police are investigating these events while denying allegations and claiming that initial reports are unfounded. Internet services were shut down temporarily to manage the chaos surrounding the protests.

title: At 19, Pincky lost 3 family members; now she’s India’s only multiple Kurash medallist
content: Pincky Balhara has secured a bronze medal in the women's -78kg Kurash event at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Games. She previously won a silver medal in the women's -52kg category at the 2018 Jakarta Asian Games. Balhara faced significant personal loss before the 2018 Games but found motivation through her father's dream. The sport of Kurash, which is related to judo, made its Asian Games debut eight years ago.

content: The Delhi High Court recently this very principle of mesne profits in a case involving a bank, directing the tenant to pay out, along with 6% annual interest, to the landlady for continuing to occupy the premises beyond the agreed tenancy period.

title: Tensions in Northern Ireland: Why the 30-year-old Garvaghy Road parade row is back
content: Northern Ireland's Parades Commission had initially kept restrictions on the march, but a court challenge overturned the decision. The commission then allowed a much smaller parade of 35 people, without bands or supporters, and required it to start by 8am and finish by 9.30am. A final court challenge by residents was also rejected, clearing the way for the march.

title: ‘Dhurandhar’ actor Akshaye Khanna buys Rs 33.26cr luxury Mumbai apartment
content: Akshaye Khanna, the esteemed actor, has made headlines with his recent acquisition of a lavish apartment in Malabar Hill, Mumbai. The purchase, finalized in September 2026 for Rs 33.26 crore, boasts over 2,500 sq ft of prime living space along with three designated parking spots. Renowned for its elite properties and central location, Malabar Hill adds yet another feather to Khanna's illustrious career in Bollywood, which spans multiple decades.

title: China cuts tariffs on US farm goods, but keeps soybeans on the other side
content: In a significant move, China has announced plans to lower tariffs on a variety of US agricultural products, while keeping the 10% tariff on soybeans intact. The revised list highlights items like corn, wheat, vegetable oils, and dairy. This action comes in the wake of discussions between Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump.

title: CBSE third-language rule: SC extends relaxations to Class VI students
content: class VI students will have to study the newly mandated third language . but they will not have to appear for a CBSE Board examination in that language when they reach class X . the exemption is currently available to students who are in classes VII and VIII .

title: Wyoming bought $1.8M hot-springs water park, may spend $1M to raze it
content: the company has already taken possession of the former Hellie's TePee Pools and is scheduled to take over the Hot Springs Hotel on Oct. 31 . the historic attraction has reached an uncertain turning point, after the state spent nearly two years and $1.8 million to regain control of the property . state officials are now weighing whether repairs make financial sense or start repairing the aging complex .

title: Crocodile found abandoned on Long Island trail; $1K reward offered
content: morelet’s crocodiles are native to Belize, northern Guatemala and parts of Mexico . a routine walk through a long Island wildlife center took an unexpected turn . the small reptile initially mistaken for an alligator was eventually identified .

title: Motorcycle-borne gunmen kill 3 cops in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
content: three traffic police officers killed in gun attack in pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province . suspected militants on motorcycles opened fire on vehicle carrying traffic police . attackers fled the area after the shooting, local police official says . no group has claimed responsibility for the latest attack .

title: Nepal: 16 feared dead after avalanche buries Himlung Himal base camp under 15ft snow
content: sixteen expedition support staff are feared dead after an avalanche buried tents at Himlung Himal base camp in the Nar Phu region of Manang . rescuers recovered two bodies while 14 others, mostly kitchen staff, remained missing . operations were suspended later in the day due to difficult conditions .

title: J&K assembly passes resolution for urgent statehood restoration amid BJP walkout
content: the resolution was moved by chief minister Omar Abdullah . it was passed despite opposition from the BJP, the largest opposition party in the assembly . jammu and Kashmir has remained a Union Territory since BJP-led centre abrogated Article 370 in august 2019 .

title: ‘Will contest at least 150 seats in UP’: Congress discusses alliance with SP
content: a party leader says the Congress is 'entitled' to contest half the seats in its alliance with the Samajwadi Party . seats-sharing talks with the SP are likely to be finalised in October . Congress has candidates available to contest all 403 seats .

title: 'Against EVMs even if we win': Akhilesh, Mayawati express distrust, cite US, Germany
content: akhilesh Yadav and bSP supremo mayawati questioned the use of electronic voting machines . he said the party would oppose EVMs even if it won "all seats" in an election .

title: Michael Mann's Hollywood Hills Villa sells for $3.5M after 2 years on market
content: the 3,002-square-foot Hollywood Hills residence, once owned by filmmaker Michael Mann, has now found a buyer for $3.5 million . it sits across two contiguous parcels totaling roughly 11,700 square feet . its combination of Mediterranean-inspired architecture, mature landscaping and sweeping views gives it a distinctly secluded character .

title: SC gives 3-month time to EC to decide on TMC name, symbol
content: the Supreme Court says it has "every reason to believe" that the west Bengal assembly speaker is "fully cognisant" of an order fixing a three-month time frame to decide petitions seeking disqualification of MLAs . the bench was referring to a January 2020 Supreme Court or a january 2020 supreme court .

title: AAP donations drop 68%; ex-MP-turned-BJP leader’s firm had given Rs 5 crore
content: the arvind Kejriwal-led Aam Aadmi Party received Rs 12.10 crore in contributions in 2025-26 . nearly 83% of the party's contributions came from two donors, Prudent Electoral Trust and Trident Limited . the remaining contributions amounted to around Rs 2.10 crore, according to the report .
